thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of Quant Equity over the last two decades, tracing the shift from simpler factor models in the early 2000s to modern complexities involving alternative data, machine learning, and AI. It argues that while the industry has learned from past crises like the 2007 Quant Quake and the 2018 value winter to become more robust and less reliant on common factors, practitioners must remain aware that these new approaches could lead to a new era of crowding if not managed carefully.
